headline: HuyenBao v11.33 — Assets tái struct 7 mục (BĐS · Cao cấp · Bình dân · Tài sản · Đấu giá & Chợ · Đồ hiếm · Workshop) + ⭐ theo dõi + đấu giá tranh mua đồ hiếm + sửa checkbox 'lỗi từ thời nào' + menu không tràn + bộ màu Emerald & Champagne + info nhân vật ghép lên status bar
summary: ASSET REGROUP + REAL RARITY. The Assets tab was rebuilt into 7 player-requested sections: Real estate, Luxury (lux>=15), Everyday goods, My assets (the collection grouped houses/wheels/collection/goods), Auction & Market (favourites watchlist + scheduled auctions + live bidding + pre-owned market), Grails and Workshop. Twelve auction-only grails (Ferrari 250 GTO, Pink Star diamond, Gutenberg leaf, T-Rex skeleton, Picasso...) NEVER appear in shops: each is announced 10-28 days ahead, then goes LIVE for 5-9 days where NPC collectors raise the top bid every 2 days, the player can be OUTBID, winning charges their bid, and losing costs nothing. A star toggle on every row/tile builds a watchlist with live values shown in the auction house. The forever-broken intro checkbox finally got a real control (visible card + 22px custom tick, dark-theme safe). Menus can no longer overflow the screen (scroll-snap + edge fade + overflow-x clip). The whole app was recoloured: Emerald & Champagne light palette and Midnight Emerald dark palette. The pinned status bar now carries the character essentials always-visible: job, education count and level with a mini XP bar.
features: ASSETS REGROUPED: 7 sections — Bất Động Sản / Đồ Cao Cấp / Đồ Bình Dân / Tài Sản / Đấu Giá & Chợ / Đồ Hiếm / Workshop
12 AUCTION-ONLY GRAILS with real estimates ($1.9M-$80M): announced 10-28d ahead, live 5-9d, NPC bids escalate every 2 days, player can be outbid
REAL RARITY: grails are delisted from every shop catalogue — the hammer is the only way in; winning delivers mint condition + 25 XP
FAVOURITES: star toggle on every row/tile; watchlist block in the auction house with live values + status (scheduled / live / listed)
CHECKUP FOR THE UI: the v11.10 disclaimer checkbox is finally a proper control — visible card, custom 22px tick, dark-theme safe
MENU OVERFLOW KILLED: scroll-snap + right-edge fade mask + overflow-x clip on the game root
RECOLOUR: 'Emerald & Champagne' (light) + 'Midnight Emerald' (dark) — jade success, coral danger, champagne-gold accents
PINNED STATUS BAR UPGRADED: job, education and level+mini-XP always visible next to age/cash/net-worth/health
TESTS: rare-auction lifecycle (schedule → live → bid → win → pay) + NPC strike-back + favourites; 158 tests green
